title: Do not run a reviewer pass under Grok plan mode. Plan mode asks for plan.md and exit_plan_mode, which conflicts with a read-only report that must be the final message.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The reviewer reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261117-215053-c643, project ork, item S402:

Do not run a reviewer pass under Grok plan mode. Plan mode asks for plan.md and exit_plan_mode, which conflicts with a read-only report that must be the final message.

Evidence: this prompt enables plan mode and the brief says the brief wins, forbids tree writes, and says ork saves the final message to reviewer-2.md
